name: Rin “Drift” Vale
role: Make the ship go where the authorities would prefer it did not.
start_text: Potency on speed-related rolls; +1d when resisting piloting consequences. Potency does not erase superior enemy systems automatically.
special_text: Potency when you Consort with or Sway unusual cultures or xenos. Describe what lets you bridge the difference; it does not give a universal extra die.
background: Labor; former tug pilot, dismissed for towing a stranded ship without permission.
friend: Triv, a ship mechanic. You always return borrowed equipment.
rival: Choss, a professional racer. You refused to throw a race.
vice: Gambling; low-stakes flight-simulator wagers at Alor’s stopover bar (campaign placement).
tie: Fuse saved your engine during the air-scrubber run; you got Anchor out before the dock shutters closed.
drive: Keep the Quiet Orbit flying without becoming someone’s owned transport.
look: Old flight jacket, close-fitting cap, hands that never stop plotting trajectories.
gear: Fine customized spacesuit 2; fine small Urbot 2; fine mechanics kit 1; grappling hook 1; Guild license 1; victory cigars 0. Your Urbot is a fictionally useful piloting helper, not an extra PC with free turns.

name: Tala “Fuse” Noor
role: Turn machinery into an answer, then keep it running long enough to escape.
start_text: Add one segment when working on a clock with Rig or Hack, or when studying a schematic. This applies during jobs and downtime; it does not create an unnecessary clock for a one-action task.
special_text: Gain one extra downtime activity to repair; your repair activity costs 0 CRED. Free repairs cannot be saved up. Ship upkeep is still a separate cost.
heritage: Spacer; family ran a repair concession.
background: Guilder; left an engineering apprenticeship over an unsafe recall.
friend: Slice, a junkyard owner. You identify useful parts before they are melted.
rival: Nisa, a previous employer. Your safety complaint cost them a contract.
vice: Obligation; repair habitat scrubbers for families without Guild cover. Purveyor/contact: Olan’s community workshop at Kestrel (original SPC).
tie: Drift trusts your emergency patches. Mercy keeps reminding you that sleep counts as maintenance.
drive: Prove small crews can keep people alive without a Guild monopoly.
look: Work coat, circuit-pattern scarf, diagnostic marks on both gloves.
gear: Fine hacking rig 1; fine ship repair tools 2; small drone 0; vision-enhancing goggles 1; spare parts 1; genius pet 0. This pregen’s pet is a tiny harmless tunnel-lizard, with no independent combat or technical skill.

name: Dev “Silk” Aran
role: Get access, recognize a lie, and give people a reason to deal.
start_text: One extra downtime activity for acquiring assets or laying low. It is restricted, not an unrestricted third activity; laying low still requires another system.
special_text: You always know when someone lies to you. This does not reveal the whole truth, and an honest mistake is not a lie.
background: Noble; former household liaison who abandoned a comfortable post.
friend: Je-zee, a diplomat. You quietly helped a stranded delegation.
rival: Manda, a Guild member. You exposed a convenient accounting error.
vice: Luxury; carefully curated meals and proper clothes, supplied by Alor’s bar (campaign detail).
tie: Anchor protected you during the scrubber handoff; you promised to make the next handoff easier.
drive: Build a reputation people can trust without surrendering your independence.
look: Repaired formal jacket, reversible collar, immaculate false confidence.
gear: Fine clothes 1; legitimate ID 0; luxury items use the load boxes on the Speaker sheet (small 0, ordinary 1, large 2); memento 0. A legitimate ID proves your identity, not a right to carry disputed cargo.

name: Kel “Anchor” Soren
role: Keep the crew safe when words stop working.
start_text: Push yourself to perform nearly superhuman force or engage a small gang on equal footing in close combat. You also receive a normal push benefit; it still has a cost unless another ability pays it.
special_text: When protecting a crewmate, resist at +1d. When you actually take harm, clear 1 stress. This is the S&V ability, not the different Blades ability with the same name.
heritage: Colonist; family maintained a failing frontier settlement.
friend: Shod, a weapons dealer. You return malfunctioning gear rather than sell it on.
rival: Chon-zek, a bounty hunter. You refused to hand over a civilian.
vice: Obligation; support an injured convoy mate through a local mutual-aid fund (original campaign contact).
tie: Silk talked down a search team while you carried an injured worker. Echo stayed with you after a bad Way crossing.
drive: Bring your people home without turning every guard into a corpse.
look: Heavy work boots, battered convoy coat, deliberately open hands.
gear: Vera fine sniper rifle 2; Zmei fine flamethrower 2; Sunder fine vibro-blade 1; Zarathustra detonator launcher 2; fine martial-art style 0; mystic ammunition 0. Heavy/illegal armament may draw extra Heat. Suggested first-job choice: ordinary blaster and armor, revealed as needed.

name: Iri “Echo” Venn
role: Notice what the Way is doing without deciding that everything strange is an enemy.
start_text: Spend a shared Gambit instead of a stress cost, including pushing or resistance. A variable-cost activation’s features are covered together; decide openly which pool resource you spend.
special_text: Use special armor to resist a Way attack or artifact-use consequence, or to push when using mystic powers. A special-armor push costs no stress. The box refreshes when choosing load for a job.
heritage: Wanderer; raised between stations and shrines.
background: Cult; left a doctrinal school over how it treated Urbots.
friend: Horux, a former teacher. They still answer your questions.
rival: Blish, a fellow mystic. They think your compassion compromises discipline.
vice: Weird; listening to low-level Way echoes with Hicks, a mystic supplier (campaign use of a published contact).
tie: Anchor trusts you with fears they will not name. You helped Mercy keep a frightened patient calm.
drive: Learn what the sector is trying to tell people nobody listens to.
look: Travel wraps, masked face, small ritual knots along one sleeve.
gear: Fine melee weapon 2; offerings 0; trappings of religion 1; outdated religious outfit 1; travel memento 0; Precursor artifact 1. The pregen artifact is an inert focus for recognizing nearby Way resonances, not a universal key, extra power, or solved research project.

name: Sana “Mercy” Pell
role: Keep the crew alive and see the person inside the problem.
start_text: Push to use your Doctor rating for a different action, explaining the patient, research, or posting that taught the trick. The normal push benefit applies as in the core rules.
special_text: Study ailments, injuries, bodies, and crime scenes. Crew recovery rolls gain +1d when you help with treatment. This stacks with the ship’s Medical Bay bonus; it does not grant the separate Patch ability.
heritage: Imperial; family served a district hospital on Warren.
background: Academic; completed medical training, then left a restrictive research grant.
friend: Alben, a former patient. You kept their care confidential.
rival: Lynie, a hospital administrator. You refused a politically useful diagnosis.
vice: Obligation; run a small free clinic rota through Juda, a doctor (campaign relationship).
tie: Fuse repairs the equipment you cannot afford to replace; you make sure they occasionally eat.
drive: Keep treatment from becoming leverage over patients.
look: Plain medical coat, rolled sleeves, a case with more patches than labels.
gear: Fine medkit 2; fine bedside manner 0; fine clothing 1; recognizable medic garb 0; candies/treats 1; syringes/applicators 0. A medical kit does not automatically clear harm during a job; use Doctor and the recovery rules, not an unselected ability.
